press_references.value: Ox Alpha’s real mystery isn’t who built it

product_launches.description: OpenCode debuted the Ox Alpha anonymous coding model on August 20, 2026. The model was presented as a long-horizon software-engineering model with a one-million-token context window and free preview pricing, although its provider and privacy terms remain unclear.

press_references.value: OpenCode Delivers a Free Open-Source Alternative to Claude Code

product_launches.description: OpenCode is presented as an already-available, free, open-source coding agent platform that serves as an alternative to proprietary tools like Claude Code, offering customizable agents, broad AI model integration, and a terminal-based interface.

press_references.value: 7 OpenCode Plugins That Make AI Coding More Powerful

product_launches.description: oh-my-openagent is an all-in-one power-pack plugin that extends the OpenCode AI coding agent with background agents, LSP and AST tools, MCP support, curated agent packs, and Claude Code compatibility, enhancing advanced coding workflows.

press_references.value: Open-source coding agents like OpenCode, Cline, and Aider are solving a huge headache for developers

product_launches.description: OpenCode launched OpenCode Go, a $10-per-month subscription that bundles access to several LLMs and simplifies managing token-heavy coding-agent workloads.

press_references.value: Anthropic cracks down on unauthorized Claude usage by third-party harnesses and rivals

product_launches.description: OpenCode introduced a new premium tier called OpenCode Black at $200 per month that routes traffic through an enterprise API gateway to work around Anthropic's new consumer OAuth restrictions.

press_references.value: Meet OpenCode, a Community-Built Agent That Trims Tokens & Costs

product_launches.description: OpenCode, an open-source AI coding agent with a terminal TUI, desktop app, semantic search (Mgrep), SDK, and editor integrations, is introduced as a new tool for developers.
